# MLive.com

> > MLive.com is Michigan's comprehensive news and information network, featuring an automotive marketplace for new and used vehicle listings across the state.

MLive.com serves as a major digital media platform for Michigan communities, providing local news, sports, entertainment, and classifieds. The site includes an extensive auto marketplace (Autos on MLive.com) that connects Michigan residents with vehicle dealers and private sellers throughout the state.
